posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked:
This is from the kickstarter

Jim came to hours later, and Con explained to him that he had made his way thousands of years into the future, and the time he'd found was terrible. All sorts of monstrous creatures populated the world now: giant yetis, Mongolian death worms, vile skunk apes, nasty chupacabras - the shorelines were overrun by New Jersey devils, what used to be Asia was now occupied by towering lizard creatures, and the seas were full of terrible serpents and sea-beasts. But the worst of all were the huge rat-men. They were the most numerous and most devious of the monsters, and they infected and destroyed everything they touched.

Fortunately, Con had a plan. Specifically, Con had a time-machine. Con could outfit Jim with new gear, fancy gadgets, and send him back in time to destroy these monsters before they could ever grow strong or reproduce. Jim agreed, but didn't much care for the idea of anyone, robot or not, messing with his pistol or his hat - they worked just fine, thank you very much.

Chrono wants to stop all the creatures, but the rats were the ones that took his arm and so Plague Rat will always have a special place in his heart, next to where he stores the extra ammo.

posts.name: TheSoundOfTrees
posts.cooked:
From Chrono Ranger update :

"All sorts of monstrous creatures populated the world now: giant yetis, Mongolian death worms, vile skunk apes, nasty chupacabras - the shorelines were overrun by New Jersey devils, what used to be Asia was now occupied by towering lizard creatures, and the seas were full of terrible serpents and sea-beasts. But the worst of all were the huge rat-men. They were the most numerous and most devious of the monsters, and they infected and destroyed everything they touched."

The monsters were in hiding, as last update says. Until Plague Rat came, and began spreading the infection. Humans began killing and/or infecting each other, driven by the disease. Untill there were few humans  left, and it was time for the creature of legends to get out of the shadows.

In other words : "zombie" apocalypse in the "28 days later" style, leaving room for the monsters to become dominant.

That's how I see it. And that's why Chrono-Ranger hunts Plague Rat, trying to destroy him/it before he can spread the infection throught he world. But the beast keeps escaping and reappearing.

Edit : not fast enough !!
